class.name: MetaHumanHairSimulation
class.brief_description: The guide curves of a groom, for hair simulation.
class.description: The guide curves of a groom as [MetaHumanHairSimulator] simulates them: their rest shape in skeleton space, [member point_count] points per guide, the skin binding of their roots (four bones and weights per guide), and the sphere colliders the hair keeps out of. The MetaHuman importer builds it from a groom's guides.

members.member: Per collider, the skeleton bone it follows.
Per collider, its center in its bone's space.
The guides' points at rest, in skeleton space: guide [code]g[/code], point [code]p[/code] is at [code]g * point_count + p[/code]. Point 0 is the root.
Four skeleton bones per guide, which its root is skinned to.
